name: 10 concurrent agent + headless-browser sessions
note: About 1.0-1.5 GB per agent plus headless-browser session, plus 8-12 GB for build bursts. Derived from one 30-minute profile of a 31 GB Windows laptop, not a benchmark of these machines.

name: 20 concurrent agent + headless-browser sessions
note: Same per-session estimate; 64 GB leaves room for builds and cache.

name: Local 30-35B mixture-of-experts at Q4
measured: Qwen3 30B Q4_K_M 86 t/s (llama.cpp Vulkan, Linux); 43-66 t/s on other runs
note: Weights about 18-21 GB at Q4_K_M plus about 4 GB KV cache. Headroom 24 GB is an estimate: OS 4 GB, 10 agent sessions 12 GB, 8 GB spare.

name: Local 70B dense at Q4
note: Weights about 40 GB at Q4 plus about 6 GB KV cache at moderate context; same 24 GB headroom estimate. Single-digit tokens/s on every 256-273 GB/s machine in the data: bandwidth, not capacity, sets the speed.

name: Local 120B-class mixture-of-experts
measured: Qwen3.5 122B Q4_K_M (81 GB) 19.2 t/s on MS-S1 MAX; gpt-oss-120b about 60 t/s on DGX Spark
note: Weights 81 GB (Qwen3.5 122B Q4_K_M, measured size) plus about 6 GB KV; needs the 128 GB class or larger. A reported Windows cap of 96 GB addressable GPU memory on 128 GB Strix Halo machines is unconfirmed.

name: Local image generation (Flux, SDXL)
note: FLUX.1-dev needs about 34 GiB unoptimised and runs under 16 GB with quantisation and offload.

name: Local video generation (Wan, HunyuanVideo, LTX)
note: Wan2.2 A14B needs 80 GB or more; TI2V-5B about 24 GB with offload. Large runs belong in rented cloud GPUs.
